notes.title: Update on December 7
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your comments and suggestions on paper bride. We have optimized and repaired it in response according to the feedbacks. The specific content is as follows:

1. Added a switch button for full screen and window mode in the setting interface
2. Added the function to close the window by pressing "ESC"

If you meet any problems during the game, please feel free to contact us .
Facebook: @gamefpscom
Twitter: @gamefpscom

notes.title: 12月4日更新说明
notes.content:
Hello, players. 
After we went online, we got the player's opinions and suggestions, and we changed and fixed the problems in today's update. 
1. Fixed the problem that the system was unable to enter the system when the name was not in English. 
If you have any other questions or need to respond to bug, you are welcome to join Facebook's official fan page: @ gamefpscom. 
Thank you for your support for "getting married". Thank you!
